title: Asset Metadata (v1)
description: Schema for asset.json, stored alongside content.<ext> at library/assets/sha256/<aa>/<hash>/asset.json. Assets are content-addressed by the exact-byte SHA-256 of content.<ext>; the directory hash and this file's sha256 field must match.

sha256.description: Exact-byte SHA-256 of content.<ext>. Must equal the <hash> directory segment.

content_file.description: Filename of the sibling content file, e.g. "content.png". Never a device-specific or personal filename.

media_type.description: IANA media type of content.<ext>, e.g. image/png, image/jpeg, video/webm.

dimensions.description: Optional pixel dimensions for image/video assets.

source_ref.description: Optional id of the library/sources/<source_id>.json this asset was retrieved from.

variants.description: Related asset content addresses derived from this asset (e.g. a downscaled thumbnail), each a full AssetRef so role is explicit.
